rule_summary: Spell trade mark as two words when writing for government.
rule_detail: ‘Trade mark’ is spelled as 2 words in the Trade Marks Act 1995. Use this spelling when writing for government, even though most dictionaries prefer ‘trademark’.

rule_summary: Do not add a full stop after Co or Inc unless they end a sentence.

rule_summary: Punctuate age references that come before a noun with hyphens.
rule_detail: - When the reference to age comes before a noun, punctuate it with [hyphens](/node/105). - Unless the age reference begins a sentence, use [numerals](/node/198).

rule_summary: Use noon, midday or midnight instead of 12 am or 12 pm.
rule_detail: Use 'noon', 'midday' or 'midnight' instead of '12 am' or '12 pm'. This is easier to understand.

rule_summary: Use two digits after the decimal point for decimal currency amounts.
rule_detail: If the amount is a decimal number, always use 2 digits after the decimal point.

rule_summary: Do not use a full stop to end headings.
rule_detail: Don’t use a full stop to end headings
method_notes: Matches headings ending with a full stop. May false-positive on abbreviations or titles that legitimately include a period. Only applies when the line being checked is the heading text.

rule_summary: Do not use a list for a single item.
rule_detail: Don’t use a list if you have only one item. Lists are only for a series of items.
method_notes: Assumes markdown-like list syntax. Flags a list when there is only one list item in a contiguous list block. May miss lists separated by blank lines or unusual formatting.
trigger_code:
import re


def check_rule(text: str):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    findings = []
    item_re = re.compile(r'^[ \t]{0,3}([-*+]|\d+[.)])\s+\S+')

    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        if not item_re.match(lines[i]):
            i += 1
            continue
        start = i
        count = 0
        while i < len(lines) and item_re.match(lines[i]):
            count += 1
            i += 1
        if count == 1:
            findings.append({'line': start + 1, 'issue': 'single-item list'})
    return findings

method_notes: Matches bullet-style lines ending with a full stop. This is a heuristic and cannot reliably determine whether an item is a full sentence or the last item in a list, so false positives are expected.
ui_flag: Avoid ending bullet-list items with a full stop unless the item is a full sentence or the last item.
